punchline: The sticky note came from a forgotten weak adhesive meeting a choir member's hymn book.
thirty_sec: At 3M, employees could spend part of their working time on projects they were curious about. A chemist trying to make a strong glue produced a weak, peelable one, and it went unused for years. Then a choir singer remembered it so his hymn-book markers would stop falling out. According to David Epstein, new ideas often come from two separate fields meeting.
